wallTime: Diagnostic only; not used to infer speedup on the saturated host.

emittedHotFunction.name: fixture.find
emittedHotFunction.scope: Static body counts, not dynamic retired instructions or cycles.

measurementMethod: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V0 user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.
wholeSuite: No whole-suite rate is extrapolated from this isolated operation benchmark. Copy-only Test262 addition A1 remains two retained 300 s post-entry timeouts.
